source_lines.78: 6.1 The contradiction discharges step 1.2, proving the numerical criterion. If $G$ is perfect, step 1.1 gives the inequality for every induced $H$. For each induced subgraph $\overline H$ of $\overline G$, [L2] gives $|V(\overline H)|=|V(H)|$, $\alpha(\overline H)=\omega(H)$, and $\omega(\overline H)=\alpha(H)$; so the same inequality holds in $\overline G$. The criterion makes $\overline G$ perfect. Applying that direction to $\overline G$ proves the converse, because $\overline{\overline G}=G$. [L2, step 1.1, step 5.1, discharge-contradiction] ∎ ## Source notes
